name: @olai/ops
//exports: Two entries, and the second is not product. `./testlib` is the planner context this package's own tests run on — ids counted from `n1`, one fixed instant — published so the package ABOVE can drive the ops layer the same way; the alternative was @olai/server keeping its own copy of that instant, which is a fixture drifting from the one the assertions in here are written against. Same argument, and the same shape, as @olai/format's.
//dependencies: Between `format` and `server` (docs/architecture.md): the ops layer knows what an edit MEANS and how a write is made durable, and nothing about a listener, a socket or a browser. @olai/format supplies the records, the rules, the canonical bytes and the refusal vocabulary; @olai/store supplies the one write gate. The ledger is a plugin now: this layer calls through a door and refuses in words when nobody stands behind it. @olai/index is the same kind of sibling one question over: it holds the trigram table a directory search takes its candidates from and decides nothing either, which is why the door that spends it is `Query.search` and the thing that opens it is `make` — one table per served directory, beside the one store. @olai/surface is deliberately absent — an op does not know it is being called over a wire.
//devDependencies: @effect/platform-node is the FileSystem the tests drive a real temp directory through, exactly as @olai/store's are. @types/node is for the node built-ins the tests reach for. @olai/log is here for its `./testlib` collector ONLY — hearing a log line has exactly one spelling in this tree. It is deliberately not a runtime dependency: the levels and the verbs are Effect's, so nothing in src/ imports it.
